title: The Dual-use Dilemma in LLMs: Do Empowering Ethical Capacities Make a Degraded Utility?
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'ethical-utility trade-off' in Large Language Models, specifically addressing the 'dual-use dilemma' in the chemical domain. It introduces the LibraChemQA benchmark to evaluate 'ethical adherence' (the ability to reject harmful/illegal requests) alongside utility, and it explicitly discusses 'ethical capacities' and 'ethical vulnerabilities'.
